title: THE FLARING ACTIVITY OF M DWARFS IN KEPLER FIELD
description:
The Kepler flux, M dwarfs that include flares,the format consist of four columns:

BKJD  Relative Flux  Fit line   Flare Flux

the Relative flux wil be empty when flares occur, the flares flux will be empty when quiescent flux.

the file lamost_obsid is the spectra used in this work, one can use the obsid to download the fits through the following website:  http://dr4.lamost.org/
